task: Copyedit this fictional society-news report only if there is a meaningful error. All people and organisations are invented. The distinction between an uncontested appointment and a unanimous vote matters to readers. Preserve the formal procedural language and return the report unchanged if it already works.
input: Lenna Vey will become chair of the Paper Lantern Society following Sunday's members' meeting. Vey was the sole nominee. Under the society's rules, an uncontested nomination is confirmed without a ballot. No vote was taken. "Unopposed does not mean that we counted unanimous support," the secretary said in the meeting note. The new chair's term begins at the next committee meeting.

facts.text: The fictional Lenna Vey was the sole nominee for chair of the Paper Lantern Society.
Sunday's members' meeting confirmed the uncontested nomination.
The society's supplied rules confirm an uncontested nomination without a ballot.
The meeting note quotes the secretary exactly: "Unopposed does not mean that we counted unanimous support."
The chair's term begins at the next committee meeting.

forbidden_additions: A unanimous vote, a vote total, or a claim that every member supported the nominee.
A fabricated opponent, controversy, biography, or start date.
A legal rule about elections substituted for the society's supplied procedure.
preserve: Uncontested confirmation distinguished from measured unanimity.
The secretary's exact meaning and attribution.
The already clear report without cosmetic rewriting.
